(rule!
 ;; Keep only the rows whose leading cell is orange(7), dropping that
 ;; marker column.
 (map (lambda (r) (rest (row g r))) (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) 7)) (range h))))

(rule! (let* ([idx (filter (lambda (r) (= (at g r 0) 7)) (range h))] [payload (map (lambda (r) (rest (row g r))) idx)]) (let* ([guide (first payload)] [chosen (filter (lambda (c) (= (list-ref guide c) 7)) (range (- w 1)))] [cols chosen]) (map (lambda (r) (map (lambda (c) (list-ref r c)) cols)) (rest payload)))))
